notes: SMARTER BOTS: every bot gets a job when it spawns and plays it like a real team player

ENTRY pushes first, SUPPORT follows a teammate and trades their fights, ANCHOR plays the objective, OVERWATCH takes the high ground and holds long angles, LURK waits and flanks alone, SLAYER goes for kills over the objective
Bots take their own lanes when they spawn, so a team spreads over the whole map instead of running in a line
S&D: attackers gather and hit the site together while a lurker cuts the rotation; defenders split over both sites and wait for a teammate before retaking a planted bomb

Free-for-all and Gun Game bots have personalities: rushers, campers, flankers and roamers. Bots slow down near danger to check corners, hear footsteps close by, and only chase what they actually saw or heard
